in_sanskrit.name: Gurman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Guide, Teacher
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gurman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gurman is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘guru’, meaning teacher or guide. In Hinduism, a guru is considered a spiritual guide and mentor, who imparts wisdom and knowledge to their students. This name is therefore bestowed upon a child who is believed to have the potential to become a wise and knowledgeable teacher or guide in the future.
